law.law: Act on the National Emblem and National Flag of the Republic of China (中華民國國徽國旗法), as amended 23 October 1954

meta.name: Taiwan
note: All the geometry is the law and its annex. The law's database lists the 1954 text as the latest amendment.

The Ministry of the Interior says no color standard exists, and offers CMYK values for reference only. Those are kept as references. The hex, Pantone and CMYK values are the Album des Pavillons 2023, as reported by FOTW.

restriction.restriction: Article 20: no symbols may be added to the flag unless a law provides for it. Article 21: its design may not be used as an exclusive commercial mark or made into any undignified article.
